title: A new branch gets the first branch's paid plan, paid-until date and founding Pro for life free
what: When an owner adds a branch, the new branch is given the first branch's MettleUp plan, billing and paid-until date. A gym that has paid for a year gets the new branch paid for the same year without paying for it. A founding gym (Pro for life, one branch) gets Pro for life on every new branch, cannot be asked to pay for it, and each branch also takes one of the 25 founding places. The add-branch sheet only speaks of the free trial.
expected: A new branch shares only the free trial. After the trial it pays its own price (half price, as the website says), and the founding offer covers one branch and uses one place.
who: owners of paid or founding gyms who add a branch; MettleUp loses the branch fee
how_often: every branch added after the gym has paid
fix_line: Copy only the trial dates to a new branch; give it its own unpaid plan, and keep the founding offer to the first branch

title: An extra branch is charged full price, but the website promises half price
what: The website and the About page say each extra branch pays half price. When a branch buys or renews its MettleUp plan, the price is worked out from the plan and monthly or yearly only, so a second or third branch is asked for the full price.
expected: A branch other than the first is asked for half the plan price, as the website says.
who: owners with more than one branch
how_often: every payment by an extra branch
fix_line: Halve the price for any branch that is not the group's first, or change the website wording

title: After live payments start, an old test connection still shows Connected and payment links quietly fail
what: A gym that connected Razorpay or Cashfree during test mode keeps a green Connected badge once MettleUp switches live payments on, and the Test mode label disappears. The server no longer makes links with a test connection, so the desk taps Make a payment link and only reads that the link could not be made, try again. Nothing tells the owner to connect again with live keys, and Paste keys is hidden while it shows Connected.
expected: The test connection is shown as needing live keys, with the paste-keys button, and the desk is told why no link can be made.
who: owners and desk staff of gyms that connected a company in test mode
how_often: every payment link, from the day live payments start
fix_line: Show a test-mode connection as needing live keys once payments are live, and say so on the desk sheet

title: The key help always tells the owner to use test keys, also when payments are live
what: When the owner opens Paste keys, the help line says to make a test key (Razorpay) or use the test keys (Cashfree), whether payments are in test mode or live. Once live, a test key is refused with a different message, so the owner is told two opposite things.
expected: In live mode the help asks for the live keys; in test mode it asks for test keys.
how_often: every connect after live payments start
fix_line: Pick the help line by test or live mode

title: A member who paid twice shows as more than due, with an I saved it button and no word about a refund
what: If the desk takes cash for a due and the member then pays an old online link, the payment comes in late and lands on Today under Paid online, receipt not made, as more than what is due. The card asks the desk to save it by hand and tap I saved it. It does not say the member has paid twice and is owed money back, although the app knows the link was paid after it was closed.
expected: The card says the member paid twice, shows both payments and asks the desk to refund one at the payment company.
who: members who pay twice; desk staff
how_often: each late payment of a closed link after the desk took the money
fix_line: Use the late flag to name it a double payment and ask for a refund instead of I saved it

title: A refund made at the payment company after the receipt is saved never reaches the admin app
what: The app asks the payment company about a refund only before it makes the receipt. If the owner later refunds the payment in Razorpay or Cashfree, the receipt stays, and the money keeps counting as collected on Today and in the reports until someone voids it by hand. Nothing reminds them.
expected: A refund found later is shown on Today so the desk can void the receipt.
who: owners who refund an online payment
how_often: each refund after the receipt was made
fix_line: Look for refunds on paid links for some days after the receipt and list them on Today

title: A cancelled payment link leaves no button to make a new one
what: When a payment link on the sheet ends as cancelled, the desk reads This link was cancelled and sees no button. A link that ran out gets a Make a payment link button; a cancelled one does not, so the desk must close and reopen the sheet.
expected: The same Make a payment link button as for a link that ran out.
fix_line: Show the make-a-link button for a cancelled link too
